text:
sam: heads-up: incbot isn't forwarding pages to oncall channels after upstream 503s. Not seeing any fanout to #oncall, starting thread. :eyes:
ops-bot: [automated] alert ingress: pager-orch delivery failure x12 (503) — relay_id=pgw-eu-1
alex: I can repro locally; outgoing webhook gets 503 + attachment header shows weird escaping
diana: @alex saw a flurry of these from eu cluster ~30m ago, thought it was transient
oncall-niko: I'm oncall, didn't receive SMS for the customer page. Phone pinged but no content arrived. escalating to ops. :fire:
maria: looking at pager-orch logs: header serialization added extra backslashes when attachments exist, downstream rejects with 503
sam: mitigation plan: route critical pages via relay-proxy for now. running quick test: ```curl -X POST https://relay-proxy.internal/push -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"alert":"smoke"}'```
alex: root cause narrowed: recent serializer change accidentally escaped header value bytes (introduced in commit 1f2b3c). prepping rollback
pagerbot: ERROR delivery: 503 -> upstream=pgw-eu-1, payload_id=0x7f4c9d, retry_count=3
ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-089 (severity=high). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paging-failure — play 1 = fallback to relay-proxy
diana: do we have customer impact? any missed external pages reported?
oncall-niko: confirmed one customer-facing page about degraded inference routing (ticket #4523). CS alerted and on call with customer now
sam: filing quick rollback. If no objections I'll roll serializer back in 10m and route traffic back to normal
maria: +1 to rollback, otherwise relay-proxy will be a longer tail risk
alex: pushing rollback patch now, will canary to eu-edge at 6554321020. Command: ```git revert 1f2b3c && ./deploy canary --region eu```
ops-bot: deploy canary started by alex at 6554321020
pagerbot: DELIVERY STATUS: canary -> pgw-eu-1 returns 200 for sample payloads
ops-bot: canary deploy succeeded. Gradual rollout to eu completed at 6554321150
oncall-niko: pages resuming; I got SMS/phone with proper content. Acknowledged, moving to mitigation phase
sam: assigning postmortem owner to alex. Please include timeline, customer impact, rollback decision, and fix for serializer tests
alex: got it. I'll include an automated unit test for header serialization and add an e2e smoke to catch this in CI
pagerbot: NOTE: 1 customer-facing page failed during window. No data exfiltration detected.
diana: I'll coordinate CS communication with support lead — thanks for rapid response everyone
sam: thanks. I'll update incident channel when postmortem draft is ready and close INC-2026-089 after retro
_meta: generated as a realistic short slack thread about paging integration break and live mitigation coordination
